The '''Imperial Heroism Medal''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] medal awarded to individuals who conducted perilous operations for the Empire with success and displayed exceptional bravery.<ref name="SWG:IHM" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> one such medal was awarded to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] alongside several Imperial supporters who had destroyed a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]].<ref name="SWG:CC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=heroic|Corellian Corvette}}</ref>

The Rebel Alliance had a similar award named [[Alliance Heroism Medal]].<ref name="SWG:AHM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=collection|Alliance Heroism Medal}}</ref>
